title: Deny-by-default communications between the trust domains

verdicts.allow: A required path, named with its protocol, endpoint, credentials and at least one prevention mechanism.
verdicts.deny: Refused; the enforcement that refuses it is named.
verdicts.disclosed: Not prevented and not required: reachable under an accepted scope, recorded with a finding.

statuses.observed: Shown today by committed evidence, with the inspection that shows it.
statuses.planned: Defined by accepted authority and observed at a named plan leaf (verify_at), which may differ from the leaf that builds it (builds_at).
statuses.decided: Decided by a decision record and built at a named plan leaf.

externals.external:off-host: Anything outside the Owner host and the execution guest: public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, the LAN and unconfigured guestfwd addresses.
externals.external:lan: The Owner's local network, reaching the Owner host from outside.
externals.external:model-provider: The model provider behind the inference broker.
externals.external:effect-targets: The targets of the executor's allowlisted operation kinds (G-04.x).
externals.external:github: The public GitHub origin of this repository.

edges.name: The guest's own processes to the inference broker through the guest inference endpoint, while a forward session is held
edges.protocol: tcp from a guest process outside every container (the operator login agent, root, a guest service) to the guest inference endpoint 172.17.0.1:8090, the guest sshd's remote-forward listener, carried by the dispatcher-held SSH session to the broker's inference listener on host 127.0.0.1

enforcement.mechanism: none in the guest: the container guard filters traffic from docker0 only and the listener is the guest's own sshd, so any guest process connects while the dispatcher holds a forward session (SLIRP's restrict=on, the enforcement of nm-guest-management, is not crossed: the session is the management channel's own)

the broker admits only a live per-attempt token in its family's auth header (decision 0015 section 3), so a guest process without one is refused (401); the listener exists only while a forward session is held

inspection: planned: S-03.2 (guest.py job-access-probe on a guest created with create --provision --inference, its forward held: the inference sweep's request from the guest login without a token; the containment case egr-inference-guest-login)
edges.notes: Found at S-03.2 slice 2 and recorded at slice 3; decision 0015 does not name this path. nm-guest-management stays the deny of every other path from the guest's own processes to the host (SLIRP restrict=on).

edges.name: A job to the inference broker through the guest inference endpoint (the only permitted path out of a container)
edges.protocol: tcp from the job to the guest inference endpoint 172.17.0.1:8090 (the guest sshd's remote-forward listener on the docker0 gateway), carried by the dispatcher-held SSH session to the broker's inference listener on host 127.0.0.1

enforcement.mechanism: container guard: one ACCEPT for new TCP from docker0 to 172.17.0.1:8090 before its refusals (INPUT, IPv4 only); the egress guard's allowlist stays empty
sshd: AllowTcpForwarding remote, GatewayPorts clientspecified and PermitListen 172.17.0.1:8090 only (local forwarding refused); the listener exists only while the dispatcher holds the forward session

the broker admits only a per-attempt token bound to the conversation, an API family, a model list, a budget and an expiry, and it alone holds the provider credential; its control listener is never forwarded

inspection: planned: S-03.2 (guest.py inspect on a guest created with create --provision --inference: the drop-in, sshd -T, the endpoint listener, the guard chains, daemon.json; job-access-probe's inference sweep; the containment cases ctl-inference-endpoint, egr-inference-*, egr-resolver-docker0 and egr-name-lookup)
edges.notes: Designed at S-03.1 and decided in decision 0015 section 4, which refines the guestfwd shape and S-01.4 ruling R5: no guestfwd and no egress-guard allowlist entry. The guest composition is opt-in per guest (create --provision --inference, declared at S-03.2 slice 2, network.inference_composition) and applying it is the Owner's guest hardening act; planned until a guest observes it.

external_edges.notes: The egress sweep's decision rule was fixed before observation (evidence/S-01.4-network-matrix.md). Observed at S-01.4, before and after a guest restart: SLIRP's aliases and the unconfigured guestfwd-class address were refused by the egress guard, whose counters rose by exactly the refused attempts; the public literals were answered by the guest's routing (ENETUNREACH, and a UDP timeout), so the guard did not engage there: FAIL under the fixed decision rule (topology, not policy), recorded. Fix-forward (Overseer ruling): with a temporary default route via 10.0.2.2 in a falsification guest, 1.1.1.1:443 and 8.8.8.8:53 (TCP and UDP) were refused from both jobs by the guard (IPv4 REJECT counters +4 tcp-reset and +2 REJECT, exactly the attempts; every LOG line OUT=enp0s4), before and after a restart: PASS; the route was removed and verified gone each time.
